card.name: Small linking words in general prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', 'or', 'then', 'of', 'to' and 'with' in ordinary web prose, usually after a noun or clause and before the next item. Also fires on a digit inside a citation number.

modes.label: Conjunctions joining items
modes.description: 'and' or 'or' linking two phrases or clauses in general web text.
modes.example: These laboratory abnormalities may progress, may remain unchanged,<< or>> may be transient with continuing therapy.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: 'then', 'of', 'to' or 'with' continuing a clause in non-medical explanations.
modes.example: If there were any other force acting upon an object,<< then>> that object would not be a projectile.

modes.label: Digit in a reference number
modes.description: A digit inside a journal citation identifier.
modes.example: Resistance in an Anopheles funestus Population from Uganda. PLoS ONE, 2010; 5 (7): e<<1>>1872 DOI: 1

card.plain: It fires on small connecting words like 'and' or 'or' in everyday text, and it nudges the model away from saying virus or infection next.
